Go to Event Website arrow_right_alt Space Tech Expo Go to Event Website arrow_right_alt MEDevice Boston Go to Event Website arrow_right_alt Upcoming Webinars Webinar Direct Metal Laser Sintering for Medical Device Development: Unlocking Complex Geometry and Performance-Driven Design September 10 • 11:00 a.m. CDT Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) gives medical device teams new freedom to design parts that would be difficult, costly, or impossible to produce with conventional manufacturing alone. In this session, we’ll explore how DMLS enables intricate geometries, internal channels and features, thin walls, tight spaces, and consolidated assemblies that can improve device performance and reduce design constraints. We’ll also discuss how engineers can balance complex, performance-driven designs with manufacturability, and where secondary machining may complement additive manufacturing to achieve critical features and tolerances. Whether you’re developing early prototypes or refining components for testing, this webinar will highlight where DMLS can create value in medical device development. Register Now Webinar Non-Metal Additive Manufacturing for Medical Devices: New Material Options for Prototyping and Development October 1 • 11:00 a.m. CDT As medical device teams push for faster iteration and more functional prototypes, non-metal additive manufacturing offers an expanding range of material options to support development. In this session, we’ll examine how polymer 3D printing can help engineers evaluate form, fit, and function while accelerating design cycles. We’ll highlight newer material options, including Med White and recently launched ABS-like materials, and discuss where they may fit within medical device prototyping and product development workflows. Attendees will gain a better understanding of how to select non-metal additive processes and materials based on application needs, performance goals, and stage of development.
